added_workstreams.title: Finish deterministic dependency-risk enforcement and exact-head canaries
acceptance_checks: Keep classification deterministic and free of filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, or package-manager execution.
Bind immutable collection evidence, candidate head, advisory snapshot, and policy digest to one exact-head receipt.
Run isolated canaries for lifecycle hooks, native builds, binary downloads, new registries, checksum loss, and graph changes.
added_workstreams.safety_boundary: The classifier cannot authorize merge or execute dependency code; autoMergeAuthorized remains false.

added_workstreams.title: Preserve daily-briefing transactional failure atomicity and exactly-once delivery
acceptance_checks: Convert every error-prone transition to validate-then-commit or transactional compare-and-swap behavior.
Prove no partial durable mutation under stale fencing, invalid receipts, storage failure, or destination failure.
Reconcile crash-before-send and crash-after-send-before-receipt without duplicate delivery.
added_workstreams.safety_boundary: No live briefing or outbound message delivery is enabled; deterministic local adapters are required.

added_workstreams.title: Clear Zed package-quartet and mixed-submodule clean-consumer blockers
acceptance_checks: Resolve clients, library, interfaces, and CLI packages through immutable Zed metadata and lockfiles.
Prove deterministic install, restore, offline reuse, uninstall, downgrade, and recursive-submodule behavior.
Compile and execute clean Rust, TypeScript, Dart, Go, and native consumers with no local-path leakage.
added_workstreams.safety_boundary: Infrastructure repositories remain outside monorepo submodules and private registry data stays redacted.

added_workstreams.title: Add resumable fabrication checkpoints, fenced recovery, and JetStream DLQ policy
acceptance_checks: Persist stage checkpoints, provider task IDs, and artifact references before polling or advancement.
ACK JetStream only after PostgreSQL commit and reject every stale fencing-token write.
Pass destructive crash, redelivery, lease-expiry, database-failure, duplicate-delivery, and DLQ recovery tests.
added_workstreams.safety_boundary: No production worker or provider call is activated; destructive scenarios run only in isolated test infrastructure.

added_workstreams.title: Build the live capability catalog and immutable portfolio release gate
acceptance_checks: Map every production capability to exact implementation heads, independent tests, maturity, and blockers.
Freeze one manifest spanning services, interfaces, SDKs, packages, migrations, configuration, topology, and artifacts.
Execute L4 independent and L5 destructive, security, scale, and recovery lanes in dependency order.
Publish a go, hold, or stop decision that fails closed on mutable references, stale evidence, missing lanes, or excess flake.
added_workstreams.safety_boundary: Certification is read-only and cannot deploy, migrate data, rotate keys, or enroll real users.

notes: The expansion references only public issue and pull-request identifiers, Linear identifiers, bounded acceptance criteria, and safety boundaries.
The five added workstreams supplement the fifteen-workstream base ledger without changing its source-completeness claim.
Every repository mutation still requires its own exact-head checks, review policy, and repository instructions.
